faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quick answers about booking, delivery and settlement.

items.question: How do I book a parcel?
items.answer: Create a merchant account and book directly from the dashboard, or connect your store to the Dhruto API for automatic bookings.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the origin, destination and service. Same-day delivery is available within the city, while nationwide delivery typically takes a few working days.

items.question: How does cash on delivery work?
items.answer: The rider collects the COD amount at the doorstep. It is then reconciled at the hub and settled into your merchant wallet.

items.question: Can I track a parcel without an account?
items.answer: Yes. Anyone with a tracking ID can use the public tracking page to view the parcel's status timeline.

items.question: What happens if delivery fails?
items.answer: The parcel follows the return-to-origin flow and is returned to the merchant instead of being abandoned.

About.title: Building delivery infrastructure for Bangladesh
About.lead: Dhruto connects merchants, hubs, riders and recipients on a single logistics platform.
About.paragraph1: Dhruto was created to solve a practical problem: growing online businesses in Bangladesh needed delivery that was reliable, trackable and financially transparent. Manual courier coordination, unclear COD reconciliation and limited tracking made shipping a source of risk rather than growth.
About.paragraph2: We built Dhruto as a logistics operating system — one connected record for every parcel, from merchant booking through hub sorting and last-mile delivery to COD settlement. Every handover is scanned, every state change is auditable, and every taka of COD is traceable.
About.paragraph3: The platform is bilingual by design, mobile-first for riders and operators, and API-ready for merchants who want to integrate delivery directly into their own systems.

items.question: How do I book a parcel?
items.answer: Create a merchant account and book directly from the dashboard, or connect your store to the Dhruto API for automatic bookings.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the origin, destination and service. Same-day delivery is available within the city, while nationwide delivery typically takes a few working days.

items.question: How does cash on delivery work?
items.answer: The rider collects the COD amount at the doorstep. It is then reconciled at the hub and settled into your merchant wallet.

items.question: Can I track a parcel without an account?

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.updated: This summary explains, in plain language, how Dhruto handles data.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the account details you provide, the shipment and recipient details needed to deliver a parcel, and operational data such as scans, status changes and delivery attempts.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: Data is used to book, route, deliver and track shipments, to reconcile cash-on-delivery, and to provide support. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Recipient data
sections.body: Recipient names, phone numbers and addresses are used to complete delivery. Public tracking deliberately masks sensitive recipient details.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: Information is shared only with parties required to complete a shipment — such as hubs, riders and payment channels — and where required by law.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Access to the platform is protected by authentication and role-based permissions, and financial actions are auditable.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: Merchants can update their account details and manage access from the portal. For data requests, contact us using the details on the contact page.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.updated: These terms govern the use of Dhruto delivery services and the merchant portal.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: Dhruto provides parcel booking, pickup, hub sorting, last-mile delivery, cash-on-delivery collection and settlement through its platform.

sections.title: Merchant responsibilities
sections.body: Merchants are responsible for accurate shipment and recipient details, for packaging, and for complying with all applicable laws and prohibited-item rules.

sections.title: Delivery and cash on delivery
sections.body: Delivery timelines are estimates. COD collected by riders is reconciled at the hub and settled according to the platform's settlement cycle.

sections.title: Fees and settlement
sections.body: Applicable delivery and COD fees are shown before a booking is confirmed. Settlement amounts reflect delivered and reconciled shipments.

sections.title: Prohibited items
sections.body: Illegal, hazardous and restricted goods may not be shipped through the platform.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms as the platform evolves. Material changes will be communicated through the portal.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent using the details on the contact page.
